summary: Our first season, and three awards: Finalist Alliance and the Reach Award at Regionals, and the Sustain Award at Nationals.

awards.name: Finalist Alliance
awards.note: Reached the final of the Regional Championship, in an alliance with our sister team Wilsobotics.

awards.name: Reach Award
awards.note: FIRST's award for outreach: inspiring and reaching people beyond the team.

awards.name: Sustain Award
awards.note: FIRST's award for building a team that lasts: planning, funding and continuity.

events.name: Regional Championship
events.note: Finalist Alliance, with our sister team Wilsobotics, and the Reach Award

events.name: National Championship
events.venue: Copper Box Arena, Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park

versions.title: Scrimmage build
versions.summary: The first robot we built as a team.

points.v: A mecanum strafer, chosen because it is simple, reliable and sturdy.
Flap wheels and a curved ramp, to pick artifacts up quickly.
Sorting turned out not to help our scoring, and the flap that fed the shooter was unreliable, which made our cycles slow.
It worked, but we had no control over the angle of its hood.

subsystems.name: Drivetrain
subsystems.body: A mecanum strafer drivetrain, chosen because it is simple, reliable and sturdy.
subsystems.detail: Four motors, one per wheel, on a frame of U-channel that keeps it stiff.

subsystems.name: Intake
subsystems.body: A flap-wheel intake with a curved ramp, for quick pick-up of artifacts.
subsystems.detail: One motor drives the flap wheels. The ramp is 3D printed.

subsystems.name: Sorter
subsystems.body: A spindexer: a drum that rotates to sort the artifacts by colour.
subsystems.detail: Two servos turn it. Sorting turned out not to help our scoring, and the flap that pushed each artifact on into the shooter was unreliable, which slowed every cycle.

subsystems.name: Shooter
subsystems.body: A hooded flywheel shooter that fires the artifacts into the goals.
subsystems.detail: One motor spins the flywheel. It worked, but the hood was fixed, so we could not control its angle.

versions.title: Regionals build
versions.summary: Rebuilt for Regionals around a custom parallel-plate drivetrain on mecanum wheels.

points.v: Polycarbonate plates, chosen for strength and for how they look. Designing our own frame gave us far more freedom over where each mechanism sits.
Our analysis showed that sorting was not worth the slower cycle times.
Flap wheels now carry each artifact from the intake to the shooter.
The drivetrain's sprockets and chains gave us problems.

subsystems.name: Drivetrain
subsystems.body: A custom parallel-plate drivetrain on mecanum wheels, built in polycarbonate.
subsystems.detail: Designing our own frame gave us far more freedom over where each mechanism sits. The wheels were driven by sprockets and chains, which gave us problems.

subsystems.name: Intake
subsystems.body: An intake that feeds artifacts up a flat ramp.

subsystems.name: Transfer
subsystems.body: Flap wheels that carry each artifact from the intake to the shooter.
subsystems.detail: It replaced V1.0's spindexer. Our analysis showed that sorting was not worth the slower cycle times.

subsystems.name: Shooter
subsystems.body: A hooded flywheel shooter with an adjustable hood.
subsystems.detail: V1.0's hood was fixed. This one lets us set its angle.

subversions.title: Nationals update
subversions.summary: The V2.0 design, with its weak points worked through for Nationals.

points.v: Timing belts and pulleys replaced the sprockets and chains.
A curved ramp replaced the flat one, with gecko wheels for compliance, to improve pick-up.
Surgical tubing replaced the flap wheels, after more testing.
The polycarbonate plates and the adjustable hood.

subsystems.name: Drivetrain
subsystems.body: The same custom parallel-plate drivetrain on mecanum wheels, now driven by timing belts and pulleys.
subsystems.detail: They replaced the sprockets and chains that gave us problems on V2.0.

subsystems.name: Intake
subsystems.body: Gecko wheels over a curved ramp.
subsystems.detail: The curved ramp replaced V2.0's flat one to improve pick-up. The gecko wheels are compliant, so they give as an artifact comes in.

subsystems.name: Transfer
subsystems.body: Surgical tubing that carries each artifact from the intake to the shooter.
subsystems.detail: It replaced V2.0's flap wheels after further testing.

subsystems.name: Shooter
subsystems.body: A hooded flywheel shooter with an adjustable hood.
